home.heroHeadline: Education shouldn't depend on where a child is born
home.heroSubtitle: UEDS works with tea-estate and upcountry communities across the central highlands of Sri Lanka.
home.visionBody: To create a future where every economically disadvantaged student in the upcountry region has equal access to quality education, empowering them to achieve their full potential and contribute to the development of their communities and nation. translate sinhala
home.missionBody: To improve education for economically disadvantaged students in the upcountry region through scholarships, academic support, school resources, and sports development, while reducing the education gap and empowering youth for positive change.
home.whatWeDoSubtitle: Six ways we work alongside upcountry communities, from the classroom to the community hall.
home.item1Body: After-school support, teacher training and learning resources for estate-area schools.
home.item2Body: Annual scholarships covering fees, materials and transport for students at risk of dropping out.
home.item3Body: Counselling, meals and health referrals for students facing hardship at home.
home.item4Body: Infrastructure and facilities — libraries, classrooms, water and sanitation — built with local communities.
home.item5Body: Prize-givings, career fairs and parent workshops held across our partner divisions.
home.item6Body: Sport, arts and holiday programmes that keep students engaged outside term time.
home.communitySubtitle: Every project starts with the tea-estate families and communities who shape it.
